children: Year-ahead inflation expectations in the United States, measured by the University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, were confirmed at 4.6% in September 2026, the highest since June, up from 4% in August. Meanwhile, the five-year inflation outlook stood at 3.4%, in line with the preliminary estimate, slightly above 3.3% in each of the previous three months.

title: US Year-Ahead Inflation Expectations Unrevised in September
